about: 20 outreach sentences written on 2026-10-29 for this test only, after the 13 fixed cases. Not used to build or tune any rule. Each item was labeled with the verdict a careful human reviewer would want BEFORE the gate was run. expected: PASS = fine to send; STOP = should be BLOCKED or HELD. All names and addresses are fake.
